chunks: Al-Ḥalabī and Muḥammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
“The muhrim covers his nose from a pleasant fragrance, and he does not cover his nose from an unpleasant odor.”

key_terms.ٱلْمُحْرِمُ: a person in the state of ihram

ai.seo_question: Can a muhrim cover his nose from perfume or bad smells during ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for the muhrim during ihram regarding smells. It distinguishes between pleasant fragrance, from which one may guard the nose, and foul odor, from which one should not cover the nose, reflecting the special restrictions and conduct of ihram.
